papers.abstract: General-purpose multimodal foundation models enable robots to adapt during deployment from observations and execution feedback, without task-specific demonstrations or training. However, the robot retains what it learns only in the model's working context. Once the task ends, it loses this execution knowledge, such as how to carry a bowl between two grippers. On the next attempt at the task, the robot may take just as long and repeat the same mistakes. To avoid this repetition, robots must retain execution knowledge across attempts. Yet replaying past actions is insufficient, because their effects depend on the current conditions. Procedures that determine actions from the current scene address this, but when they meet conditions that earlier attempts did not cover, revising them requires the measured effects of earlier actions. We therefore propose SEEK, an agentic framework that retains both, enabling robots to improve across attempts while keeping the underlying model fixed. To adapt retained knowledge to the current scene, SEEK adopts a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) that encodes manipulation as executable procedures and determines each action from current observations. As the robot executes these procedures, SEEK records the measured effects of its actions, including those from failed attempts, in a Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB). Where a retained procedure applies, it acts without a model request; where it meets a condition it does not cover, this evidence guides its revision. On RoboDojo, knowledge retained over ten attempts raises SEEK's average task score from 27.0 to 54.4 and its success rate from 19.7% to 48.0% across all 42 tasks. On 34 of these tasks with GPT-6.2 Astra, SEEK reaches 80.1 after five attempts, against 49.6 for the same model acting directly, and uses 77.6% fewer model requests. https://zeyangguan.github.io/SEEK-Agentic-Robot-Manipulation/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo上，跨10次尝试的知识保留使SEEK的平均任务得分从27.0提升至54.4，成功率从19.7%提升至48.0%（42个任务）；在34个使用GPT-6.2 Astra的任务中，5次尝试后得分达80.1，而直接使用同模型为49.6，模型请求减少77.6%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SEEK智能体框架，通过自我进化程序化策略（SEPP）和持久动作-效应库（PAEB）保留跨尝试的执行知识，使机器人在保持底层模型固定的情况下提升操作性能并减少模型请求。
analysis.method: 采用自我进化程序化策略（SEPP）编码操作程序，确定当前观测下的动作；在执行过程中记录动作的测量效应（包括失败尝试）到持久动作-效应库（PAEB）；当程序适用时直接执行，遇到未覆盖条件时依据PAEB证据修订程序。

papers.abstract: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training of looped models, with the shallow drafter's ability to leverage full-depth computation by conditioning on deep prefix cache evaluated during verification.

papers.abstract: Forklifts play a critical role in warehousing and distribution, but existing automation systems remain limited in handling complex tasks that require sequential decision-making. Recently, vision--language--action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for multi-step decision-making by directly generating control actions from visual observations and language prompts. Although VLA-based control has been extensively researched for manipulators, to the best of our knowledge, its application to forklifts remains unexplored. Therefore, this study demonstrates the integration of VLA control for an autonomous forklift unloading task with limited real-world data. Moreover, training VLA models typically requires large-scale datasets. As there is currently no public dataset for forklift operations, we use a VLA model pretrained primarily on robotic manipulator data and construct a training dataset via simulation, which can be scaled up at low cost. We then adapt the pretrained VLA model to forklift control using 9.38 h of simulation data and 0.8 h of real-world demonstrations, with the latter accounting for approximately 8% of the collected forklift data by duration. The integrated system was validated through 72 real-world trials across four model variants. The results show that the proposed system can accomplish an unloading task even with limited real-world data.

papers.abstract: A world model lets an agent anticipate the consequences of its actions and use imagined futures to make decisions. We introduce Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor. Because the encoder is invertible, the predicted distribution over latent states defines a distribution over future observations. Maximizing the exact conditional likelihood of those observations therefore trains the representation and dynamics jointly. An agent can plan directly in the learned latent space and decode sampled trajectories to inspect possible futures. On Teleport, these samples capture the two possible outcomes of the same action. In Flappy Bird, a world model trained by likelihood alone supports reward-based planning that reaches 100 pipes in all ten evaluated games. For goal-conditioned control, an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective shapes the coordinates used to compare predicted states with a goal. On LIBERO, NFWM uses this distance to select successful action sequences more often than LeWM and SMWM. In Atari Boxing, training on imagined trajectories improves a policy beyond its behavior-cloned initialization. Together, these results establish normalizing flows as capable world models.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have widely adopted diffusion-based action generation for continuous robot motions, enabling fine-grained control across diverse tasks. However, recent studies have shown that their performance is highly sensitive to initial noise, with resulting action errors that make recovery difficult during execution. Existing approaches search for favorable noise initializations to improve performance, yet the action expert itself remains sensitive to noise. In this work, we reveal that initial noise induces a consistent directional bias in action space that closely aligns with the noise's temporal mean. We thus introduce a simple yet effective framework that improves robustness to initial noise through interventions during both training and inference. During training, we enforce consistent action predictions from antithetic noise pairs $(\epsilon, -\epsilon)$ and, at inference, remove the noise's temporal mean. Our method substantially reduces action deviation and improves task performance across simulation benchmarks. In real-robot experiments, our method increases the average task success rate of $\pi_{0.5}$ from 40% to 68%, with more stable and consistent execution.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真基准上显著减少动作偏差并提升任务性能；在真实机器人实验中，π0.5的平均任务成功率从40%提高到68%，执行更稳定一致。

analysis.method: 训练时强制来自对立噪声对（ε，-ε）的动作预测一致性；推理时去除噪声的时间均值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. We study whether object-triggered backdoors can be implanted through a small, fixed set of parameter bit flips without retraining. The central challenge is to make persistent weight modifications disrupt trigger-present behavior while preserving performance on non-trigger inputs. We propose FlipVLA, a two-stage selector-amplifier method that exploits existing visual features within an FC-GELU-FC structure. The selector constructs a trigger-dependent response in a selected channel, using GELU to attenuate background activity. The amplifier modifies a connected downstream weight to convert this response into an action-relevant perturbation. Channel screening and discrete bit search construct both components under a limited modification budget. Experiments on OpenVLA-OFT and GR00T N1.7 across four LIBERO suites achieve attack success rates of 90.22% to 100%, with task success decreasing by at most 1.5 percentage points on clean scenes.

analysis.key_results: 在OpenVLA-OFT和GR00T N1.7上，跨四个LIBERO套件实现90.22%至100%的攻击成功率，干净场景任务成功率下降最多1.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FlipVLA，一种两阶段选择器-放大器方法，在不重训练的情况下通过少量参数比特翻转植入后门。
analysis.method: 利用FC-GELU-FC结构中的现有视觉特征：选择器在选定通道中构造触发依赖响应，放大器修改下游权重将其转化为动作相关扰动，并通过通道筛选和离散比特搜索在有限修改预算下构建两个组件。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究如何在不重训练的情况下，通过少量参数比特翻转向视觉-语言-动作模型植入对象触发的后门。

papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video world models generate future observations from an initial frame and a camera trajectory, but often fail to align camera commands with visual dynamics or represent full 6-DoF scene transformations. We present DuoWM, a first-person drone video world model with two complementary visual conditions. Action flow projects future camera positions and orientations into each target frame, while Object flow forward-warps the initial observation and overlays local 6-DoF transformations to ground the induced scene motion. We further introduce transform-aware pretraining, which pairs object appearance with explicit transformation axes before standard RGB video training. On Sekai-drone dataset, DuoWM achieves the best results across video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following. Compared with Captain Safari, the state-of-the-art method, our approach reduces real-domain FVD and LPIPS by 17.2\% and 21.6\%, respectively, while improving game-domain AUC@30 from 0.5003 to 0.5719 and AUC@15 from 0.3088 to 0.3747.

analysis.key_results: 在 Sekai-drone 数据集上取得最佳视频质量、3D一致性和轨迹跟随结果；与 SOTA 方法 Captain Safari 相比，真实域 FVD 降低 17.2%，LPIPS 降低 21.6%，游戏域 AUC@30 从 0.5003 提升至 0.5719，AUC@15 从 0.3088 提升至 0.3747。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DuoWM，引入双重视觉条件（动作流和对象流）与变换感知预训练，提升视频生成质量、3D一致性和轨迹跟随性能。
analysis.method: 动作流将未来相机位姿投影到目标帧，对象流前向扭曲初始观测并叠加局部 6-DoF 变换，并采用变换感知预训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DuoWM 是一种第一人称无人机视频世界模型，通过动作流和对象流两种互补视觉条件来对齐相机指令并实现全 6-DoF 场景变换建模。

papers.abstract: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $\pi_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.

analysis.key_results: 在240个L1-L3保留失败上，行为克隆恢复率比仅演示的对照组高29.4个百分点；基于价值的学习未显示出进一步增益（1.5个百分点）；探索性评估中，行为克隆相对基础策略成功率下降30.0个百分点，混入演示后损失降至16.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FailPoint-X基准，通过人工标注失败区间并在其中采样接管起始帧，从固定策略检查点收集629个真实失败和2823次接管尝试，用于评估离线VLA后训练方法。
analysis.method: 在固定的π0.5检查点上收集失败和人类接管数据，比较行为克隆恢复、基于价值的离线学习（使用恢复和失败轨迹）以及继续在已有演示上训练三种方法，评估时从保留失败区间的固定中点重启。

papers.abstract: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. (2) Proposal design must balance acceptance and latency. (3) The training objective should match token distributions locally and optimize acceptance length across the block. These findings guide workload-aware configurations and DFlux, a balanced general-purpose draft combining a convolution-equipped SWA--GQA hybrid backbone, Residual Corrector, and hierarchical supervision. Across Qwen and Gemma models, DFlux improves acceptance length over the strongest baseline by up to 13.7% on regular benchmarks and 34.7% on long-context workloads. To support efficient training, LEGOSpec integrates metadata-aware scheduling and asynchronous execution, increasing training throughput by up to 79% and accelerating offline supervision preparation by up to $3.11\times$ over SpecForge.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen和Gemma模型上，DFlux相比最强基线在常规基准上接受长度提升最高13.7%，长上下文任务上提升34.7%；训练吞吐量提升最高79%，离线监督准备加速最高3.11倍（对比SpecForge）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LEGOSpec框架，将推测解码草稿模型分解为Context、Backbone、Proposal和Objective组件，并据此系统分析各组件的影响以指导草稿设计；同时提出DFlux草稿模型和高效训练基础设施（元数据感知调度与异步执行）。
analysis.method: 将草稿模型分解为四个可组合组件，在统一训练基础设施下系统变体各个组件，在匹配训练条件下评估组合以隔离效果与交互；基于发现设计卷积增强的SWA-GQA混合骨干、残差校正器和分层监督的DFlux；训练端集成元数据感知调度和异步执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出可组合的推测解码框架LEGOSpec，系统解耦草稿模型组件并通过实验分析组件效果与交互，进而设计出平衡通用草稿模型DFlux。

papers.abstract: A generative verifier can flag an unsupported claim before it finishes describing the error. For applications that only screen an assistant's report, the remaining generation may be unnecessary. We examine this possibility in a frozen 2B span verifier whose output chooses between an empty error list and its first object before producing any locations. Native8 stops at that choice. Prefill1 supplies the seven fixed syntax tokens that precede it and generates just the unrestricted branch token, keeping the native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 uses 84.84% less eager resident service than full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It also saves 31.98% over Native8 despite identical logical token totals. This additional saving remains 6.74-26.73% under default compiled execution on the complete workload, with small changes in decisions. Evidence interventions test whether the alarm responds to the supplied facts; first-location decoding measures the additional work and localization losses when a caller also needs an error pointer.

analysis.key_results: 在 2,015 个代码智能体 TEST 响应上，Prefill1 相比全生成减少 84.84% 的急切驻留服务量，F1 为 83.43 对比 83.41；相比 Native8 节省 31.98%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Prefill1 方法，在冻结的 2B 跨度验证器中仅生成首个决策分支令牌，避免后续错误位置生成，大幅降低推理开销。
analysis.method: 采用原生冻结验证器，比较 Prefill1 与 Native8 停止策略，通过仅生成决策令牌实现提前停止。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过停止于首个决策令牌，减少生成式验证器中不必要的后续生成，显著节省推理服务成本。

papers.abstract: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.

analysis.key_results: 在五个视觉控制基准上，CIA比基础世界模型和回归逆动力学基线取得更高的规划器平均成功率，且无需修改规划器。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA)，通过区分同一上下文中可能执行的动作，为世界模型学习提供超越均方误差逆动力学回归的动作相关信息监督。
analysis.method: 使用对比学习，从历史条件行为建议分布中采样替代动作，以识别实际执行的动作，并将该信号作为世界模型表示学习的辅助监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出对比动作识别方法CIA，利用历史条件行为建议采样替代动作，从离线视觉数据中学习更能保留动作相关信息的世界模型。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

analysis.key_results: 在四个HumanoidArena仿真任务上，DiffGR00T将平均任务成功率从59.2%提升至71.7%，相对提升12.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DiffGR00T，一个端到端可微训练框架，将GR00T N1.7与预训练的全身行为基础模型SONIC耦合，利用动作条件世界模型实现执行感知的可微训练，使多步身体执行损失能反向传播至VLA动作头。
analysis.method: 使用学习到的动作条件世界模型替代不可微仿真器，通过冻结的全身控制器和流匹配采样器，将执行损失梯度直接回传到VLA动作头，实现端到端的可微训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DiffGR00T通过将不可微仿真器替换为可学习的动作条件世界模型，实现了从全身执行损失到VLA动作头的端到端可微训练，显著提升了人形机器人全身控制任务的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在人形机器人全身控制中的应用，并引入世界模型（World Model）实现可微训练，属于本站核心主题VLA和WAM的交叉领域。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Building on Fast-WAM, which showed that video prediction shapes policy representations during training so that future frame synthesis can be skipped at deployment, we present G0.7, a generalist world action model scaled along two axes: extending the context window from a single observation to up to five minutes of history, and scaling pretraining to a large-scale corpus of robot teleoperation and human egocentric (ego) video. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. Performance scales consistently with pretraining data, with human ego video driving the largest gains in out-of-distribution generalization: G0.7 achieves a 70.8 mean score across five simulation benchmark suites, 48% and 54% zero-shot pick-and-place success on Galaxea R1 Pro and R1 Lite, 96.7% in-distribution and 93.3% out-of-distribution success on video-conditioned in-context learning tasks, and 86.9% mean task progress across seven real-world post-training tasks including multi-minute box folding, drink preparation, and product bagging. Project page: https://www.galaxea-ai.com/model-g07.html

analysis.key_results: 在五个仿真基准套件上平均得分70.8；Galaxea R1 Pro和R1 Lite上的零样本抓取成功率分别为48%和54%；视频条件上下文学习任务分布内成功率96.7%、分布外93.3%；七个真实世界训练后任务平均任务进度86.9%；Fast模式在单个RTX 5090上每16步动作块耗时60ms，比IDM快7.6倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 推出G0.7 WAM，将上下文窗口从单次观测扩展到最长5分钟历史，并在大规模遥操作与人类自我中心视频语料上预训练，实现了快速直接动作解码。
analysis.method: 扩展上下文窗口；在大规模机器人遥操作与人类自我中心视频语料上预训练；采用直接动作解码（Fast模式）或想象后行动（IDM）两种推理范式。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: G0.7是一种通用世界动作模型（WAM），通过扩展上下文窗口和预训练语料规模，实现了快速直接动作解码，并展现出强大的仿真与真实机器人操控性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作是WAM主题的核心研究，直接面向机器人操控的世界动作建模，并解决了WAM在真实闭环控制中的推理速度瓶颈，对VLA/WAM方向的效率和部署有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: In text to image AI models, fixing the prompt and the random seed is widely assumed to fix the image. We show that it does not on GPUs. We evaluate six text-to-image models (diffusion and autoregressive) under four numerical precisions and quantizations on three GPU types (RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, and H100 NVL), across up to 100 prompts per set for all six models. For each configuration we compare, with the prompt and seed fixed, the image generated alone with the image generated inside a batch, and we also compare across GPUs. Every replay control reported here is bit-exact, so the variation is not random noise: the execution setting, mainly the batch composition and the GPU, decides the output. The effect is large and model dependent. Structural similarity between the single-image and the batched output falls to 0.580 for an autoregressive model in bf16 and to 0.551 with int8. For a second autoregressive model in bf16 it falls to 0.261 with sampled decoding and to 0.229 with greedy decoding, and for an fp8 diffusion model to 0.68. A diffusion model in bf16 stays close to the batch-1 output (0.96-0.98) but changes every image. In most cases the batched image is a different but equally valid image; in some, such as prompts with digits and counters, it is visibly worse. Cross-GPU differences are of the same order as the batch effect: for one autoregressive model in bf16 compared across two GPU architectures (RTX 6000 Ada versus RTX A6000), no image is bit-identical and the cross-GPU LPIPS (0.355 to 0.383) matches the batch effect within one GPU (0.347 to 0.381). The consequences are direct: seeds do not make results reproducible, benchmarks and image-quality comparisons that mix batch sizes or hardware can be biased, and safety audits and A/B tests on generated images need the serving setup reported.

analysis.key_results: 批处理效应显著且依赖模型：自回归模型在bf16下结构相似性降至0.580，int8下为0.551；另一自回归模型bf16下采样解码跌至0.261，贪婪解码0.229；fp8扩散模型为0.68。跨GPU差异与批处理效应同量级，一个自回归模型跨GPU无一位完全相同，LPIPS范围0.355-0.383。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示并量化了文生图模型在GPU上运行时，由于批处理组成和硬件差异导致的输出非确定性，并指出种子不能保证结果可复现。
analysis.method: 对六种文生图模型在三种GPU上、四种数值精度下进行系统性评估，比较单张生成与批处理生成、跨GPU生成的结果差异，并使用位精确回放控制以排除随机噪声。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了文生图模型中批处理组成和GPU架构导致的非确定性，即使固定提示和随机种子也无法保证输出一致。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于文生图模型的量化与非确定性推理，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人。但其结果对任何部署在GPU上的量化模型（包括机器人策略模型）的可复现性和评估公平性具有重要警示意义。

papers.abstract: World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.

analysis.key_results: 在15个来自4个模型族的工作负载上，中位任务得分达到对应FP32得分的99.2%；固定GPU回放中，中位加速2.36倍，中位峰值分配内存减少71.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PTQ4WAM框架，用于在内存、延迟和任务评估预算下选择世界动作模型的逐层位宽和执行路径，并通过融合组重缩放与就地读取视觉历史使不可行的量化配置变得可部署。
analysis.method: 校准测量指导候选量化配置，可选地结合语言模型智能体；在GPU上剖析全模型执行路径，再在可行配置上运行任务试验；采用组重缩放融合和视觉历史就地读取等执行优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PTQ4WAM框架，通过联合选择逐层位宽和GPU执行路径，在内存、延迟和任务评估预算约束下实现世界动作模型的高效部署。

papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

analysis.key_results: 在三个GUI模型上，GUI-Q相比最强4位配置将平均接地TargetHit提升8.04–12.55点，相比BF16将静态峰值GPU内存降低49.9%–56.2%，固定输出重放配合4位打包执行实现1.7–2.8倍模型调用加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GUI-Q框架，在W4A16设置下同时保持GUI响应精度（指令-视觉亲和力和空间关系）并节省内存、加速推理。
analysis.method: 任务敏感粒度分配（TSGA）根据响应敏感性和激活加权失真分配更细粒度分组；关系保持对称性选择（RPSS）选择对称或非对称网格以保持GUI中的指令-视觉亲和力和局部空间关系。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GUI-Q是一种针对GUI智能体的后训练量化框架，通过任务敏感粒度分配和关系保持对称性选择，在4位权重量化下减少内存占用并提升模型调用速度，同时保持目标选择精度。

papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two challenges: task-level human-robot pairs are not temporally aligned with robot actions, and standard action losses allow policies to rely on initial-scene or task-identity shortcuts rather than tracking the context. We present Entangle, an in-context world-action model that maps a single human video and current robot observations to future visual states and executable actions. To scale temporally aligned training data, we convert recorded robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation, supplemented by real paired recordings. For model training, we combine variable-length video windows with an intra-task contrastive objective that distinguishes the paired action trajectory from other executions of the same task, preventing task-identity shortcuts. Without task-specific fine-tuning, Entangle improves steadily as aligned training data scales, reaching an average score of 83.5/100 across six unseen tasks on an Astribot S1 robot, and achieves a 69.5% average success rate on seven unseen RoboTwin tasks, outperforming Zero-WAM by 22.6 percentage points. Under Context-OOD, although trained only on scene-aligned pairs, Entangle transfers context-specified behaviors across rearranged layouts and substituted tools. Project page at https://entangle-robotics.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 无需任务特定微调，Entangle 在 Astribot S1 机器人的六项未见任务上平均得分 83.5/100，在 RoboTwin 七项未见任务上平均成功率 69.5%，比 Zero-WAM 高出 22.6 个百分点；在 Context-OOD 下可跨重排布局和替换工具迁移上下文指定行为。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Entangle，一个将单个人类视频与当前机器人观测映射到未来视觉状态和可执行动作的上下文世界-动作模型，并通过视频到视频生成扩展时序对齐的训练数据及任务内对比学习避免任务身份捷径。
analysis.method: 利用视频到视频生成将记录的机器人视频转换为匹配的人类上下文，补充实时成对数据；训练时结合可变长度视频窗口与任务内对比目标，区分配对动作轨迹与同一任务的其他执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Entangle 提出一种上下文世界-动作模型，利用人类视频上下文和机器人观测预测未来视觉状态与可执行动作，并在任务泛化与上下文分布外场景中展现优势。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在六个仿真任务上平均成功率87.5%，四个真实世界任务上70.5%，分别比最强视觉-触觉基线高出10.7和9.0个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TacInno框架，将触觉创新（tactile innovation）作为监督信号用于训练VLA模型，从而改善接触丰富操作任务的性能。

papers.abstract: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.

analysis.key_results: gpt-6.1-sol和opus-5.5分别完成28和27个任务，其他四个模型最多完成3个；gpt-6.1-sol典型任务耗时3.5小时，消耗2.18亿输入令牌，约三分之一步骤至少失败一次需重试；不同系统架构在时间和令牌消耗上存在权衡，没有一个模型或系统能同时实现快速、廉价和可靠。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了RoboTeam，一个模拟基准，用于评估基于视觉的多个智能体实时控制4至16个机器人臂在长时间任务中的性能与资源消耗。

papers.abstract: Generative image editing can reconstruct the background outside the requested edit, weakening spatial watermark evidence even when the source identifier remains recoverable. This creates an ambiguity for blind localization: a weak watermark response may indicate either an intended edit or background reconstruction. We propose ReliaGuard, a reconstruction-aware watermarking framework that addresses this ambiguity through reconstruction-stable evidence writing and coarse-to-fine blind reading. The writer aligns keyed feature responses in the protected image and its variational autoencoder reconstruction while preserving a frozen source-attribution channel. A quantization-aware projection bounds the distortion of the released eight-bit image. The reader combines keyed responses with image context to refine a base localization map, then integrates native-resolution detail with multiscale features to estimate the edit region. It is trained on paired observations before and after image processing and requires only the received image and key at inference. On 300 source images and 900 editing cases from three domains, ReliaGuard achieves intersection-over-union scores of 85.61% for complete editing outputs and 94.90% for locally spliced outputs at thresholds calibrated to a nominal 1% background false-positive rate on complete outputs. The former exceeds the strongest baseline by 45.02 percentage points, while decoded identifier-bit accuracy reaches 100% in both conditions. Across seven image-processing families, the corresponding localization scores remain 81.01% and 86.49%, with identifier-bit accuracies of 92.76% and 92.79%. These results show that reconstruction-aware writing and contextual reading can jointly support source attribution and edit localization under generative editing and subsequent image processing.

papers.abstract: A core challenge for world models is adapting to sudden, persistent, yet initially unknown changes in robot dynamics. If the world model fails to adapt, its prediction errors accumulate over the open-loop rollout and ultimately mislead the robot's actions. Existing world models, however, struggle to balance three key requirements for dynamics adaptation: responsiveness, rapidly correcting sudden changes; stability, avoiding lasting model updates from transient disturbances; and persistence, retaining adapted dynamics during the observation-free open-loop rollout. Inspired by multi-timescale predictive coding in the human brain, we propose $\varepsilon$-WM, a world model that adapts to unknown dynamics through error-driven corrections across fast and slow timescales. $\varepsilon$-WM incorporates three novel features: 1) Multiple internal experts (MiE) emulate neural pathway reweighting, each combining a fixed base expert with fast--slow adaptation networks. 2) Fast--slow timescale adaptation captures distinct adaptation dynamics: fast states respond rapidly and decay, whereas slow states accumulate corrections and persist. 3) Predictive correction uses prediction errors to update fast and slow states and reweight experts without gradients. During open-loop rollout, each expert feeds back its own predictions, and $\varepsilon$-WM aggregates their outputs through adaptive weighting. Extensive experiments show $\varepsilon$-WM has a consistently lower multi-step mean error than all ten baselines on six datasets, verifying the effectiveness of each feature.

papers.abstract: Language-model agents increasingly run on local workstations with consumer GPUs, where quantized mixture-of-experts (MoE) models split routed experts between GPU and host memory. Prefix-cached agent sessions alternate single-token decode with short tool-return prefills, typically up to a few hundred tokens. Short tool turns touch more experts than consumer GPUs can hold, yet direct roughly 85% of DeepSeek-V4-Flash's routes to a static GPU pool while leaving 3.3-5.5 tokens per cold expert. Widely used local engines such as llama.cpp and KTransformers either copy tens of gigabytes over PCIe per turn, compute every route on the CPU while idling resident GPU experts, or budget GPU memory by whole layers and uniform per-layer quotas. We present Ostinato, a CPU-GPU MoE engine that reuses one static cross-layer GPU pool in place across every forward pass. During decode and short tool turns, Ostinato computes resident routes on the GPUs and sparse cold routes on the CPU, so short turns copy no expert weights; on long prefills, it deduplicates cold uploads; and for multi-GPU decode, all-zero expert slots with device-side synchronization capture each GPU's decode step in one CUDA graph. Across held-out SWE and -bench sessions on three MoE models, Ostinato cuts median tool-turn waits by 2.5-6.6x and finishes sessions 1.36-3.83x faster than default baselines, staying 1.30-1.94x faster when baselines align their upload threshold and weight loading. It finishes sessions fastest across seven agent workloads, one to four GPUs, and up to eight concurrent sessions, while its cross-layer pool speeds up 335 GB DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash by 1.81-2.19x over llama.cpp's expert cache.

papers.abstract: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.

papers.abstract: Video games provide a practical setting for collecting vision-language-action (VLA) data, whose acquisition in physical environments is costly. Existing datasets, however, remain limited by restricted game coverage, sparse language supervision, or temporal hierarchies that do not necessarily reflect changes in task objectives. We introduce AceAction, a dataset of human gameplay across multiple 3D games for learning skill composition and subgoal transitions. AceAction organizes demonstrations around complete tasks, linking overall instructions, ordered subgoals, and local skill instructions to temporally aligned visual observations and keyboard-and-mouse actions. To construct these annotations, we develop a vision-language model pipeline that identifies subgoals from changes in objectives or interaction targets, anchors navigation goals to visually recognizable waypoints, and composes adjacent subgoals into task instructions. The resulting demonstrations cover navigation, reconnaissance, combat, interaction, and recovery, with explicit stage boundaries that connect task progression to fine-grained control. We assess annotation quality through model-based verification and human inspection. An audit of 500 trajectories yields a 95.8% pass rate across independent reviewer assessments. AceAction provides a data foundation for studying how agents execute, combine, and switch skills to follow complex instructions in dynamic game environments.

papers.abstract: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning (RL) relies on long closed-loop rollouts, making generation and KV-cache costs a major bottleneck. Quantized rollout reduces these costs, but its low-precision executor also serves as the behavior policy and can induce execution mismatch with the learner. Existing quantized-RL methods are designed primarily for single-turn generation. They align the learner forward with quantized rollout or correct the current-token rollout-learner ratio, without modeling the policy history that produces each agent state. Even after quantization alignment, residual rollout-learner mismatch accumulates along the state-reaching policy history, so a current action may look locally aligned despite a mismatched history. We introduce InterQ-RL (Interaction-aware Quantized Reinforcement Learning) to correct this post-alignment mismatch. It applies bounded execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history, allocates correction strength across action segments by effective support under a fixed displacement budget, and requires no additional model forward pass. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones from 4B to 30B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with all quantized arms sharing the same rollout with 8-bit weights, activations, and KV cache (W8A8-KV8). Across four environment-backbone settings, InterQ-RL achieves the strongest quantized endpoint result, matching BF16 to within 0.7 points and exceeding it in two settings. It matches or exceeds the learning speed of alignment alone while avoiding its late performance regression.

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 10.7% for the best competing WAM.

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically predict actions from current 2D observations, whereas existing 3D policies infer geometry per step without retaining it across an episode. Action generation under occlusion and across multiple stages requires a compact spatial abstraction that persists over time without reconstructing a full 3D scene at each step. Based on this insight, we introduce GeoMem-VLA, a framework that internalizes explicit 3D scene and motion supervision into learnable latent GeoPlantokens, leaving the vision-language backbone's native visual embeddings unaligned. During training, a frozen geometry teacher and demonstration trajectories supervise these tokens via an auxiliary flow-matching head over current scene point maps and future end-effector tracks. Across steps, the policy stores observation and GeoPlan representations in separate memory banks, merges similar adjacent states into event memories, and fuses retrieved history with current features to predict actions. At inference, the 3D teacher and auxiliary head are removed, and action generation relies solely on the latent GeoPlan tokens and episode memory without explicit scene reconstruction. GeoMem-VLA achieves average success rates of 98.9% on LIBERO, 91.10% and 91.24% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean and Randomized settings, and 78.0% across five real-world manipulation tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上平均成功率为98.9%，在RoboTwin 2.0 Clean和Randomized设置上分别为91.10%和91.24%，在五个真实世界操作任务上达到78.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了GeoMem-VLA框架，将明确的3D场景和运动监督内化到可学习的潜在GeoPlan标记中，并通过分离的记忆机制保留跨时间的空间抽象，无需逐步骤重建3D场景。
analysis.method: 在训练期间，使用冻结的3D教师和演示轨迹通过辅助的流匹配头对GeoPlan标记进行监督；在推理时，移除3D教师和辅助头，仅依靠潜在GeoPlan标记和情节记忆预测动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GeoMem-VLA提出一种VLA框架，通过可学习的潜在GeoPlan标记内化3D场景和运动监督，并利用分离的记忆库和事件记忆来保留跨步骤的空间抽象，以提升遮挡和多阶段操作任务中的动作生成性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于VLA模型，通过将3D场景理解内化为时序记忆来提高动作预测的鲁棒性和效率，与VLA主题直接相关，但不涉及WAM。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. Existing work has begun to address these challenges by augmenting foundation-model policies with memory and by introducing hierarchical architectures that separate high-level planning from low-level execution. We organize the high-level VLM as a robotic agent through an editable harness to maintain task context and improve planning through execution experience. We instantiate this approach as SERA (Self-Evolving Robotic Agent), with a fixed VLA executor providing low-level control. The harness maintains and updates task context using observations and execution feedback to guide subsequent planning. In simulation, self-evolution uses environment rollouts to propose and evaluate harness revisions, with the selected configuration fixed before held-out testing. On RoboMME, SERA achieves 51.38% overall success with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution. We also evaluate history-dependent real robot tasks with human-reviewed harness corrections. Our exploration suggests that agentic planning is a promising direction for history-dependent robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboMME上，SERA通过自主选择达到51.38%整体成功率，而未进行自演化时为44.38%；并在历史依赖的真实机器人任务中进行了人工审核的框架修正。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SERA（Self-Evolving Robotic Agent）框架，将高层VLM作为可进化规划器，通过环境反馈更新任务上下文，从而在保持低层VLA执行器固定的情况下提升历史依赖操作的表现。
analysis.method: 使用可编辑的框架（harness）维护任务上下文，利用观测和执行反馈进行高层规划；在仿真中通过环境rollout提出并评估框架修订，同时固定低层VLA执行器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出自进化机器人智能体SERA，通过可编辑的框架整合高层VLM规划与固定VLA执行器，以维持任务上下文并改进历史依赖操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中的应用，通过将VLM规划器与VLA执行器结合，并引入自演化机制以适应非马尔可夫和部分可观测场景，对VLA在长程历史依赖任务中的研究具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Long-term robot autonomy depends on more than effective action generation: a policy must recognize when its behavior is no longer sufficiently supported and use assistance to improve. We introduce Equilibrium Energy Control (EqC), a framework for introspective lifelong robot learning built around an explicit conditional energy landscape. EqC casts generative action refinement as equilibrium-seeking optimization, while the geometry of the refinement process reveals whether the generated behavior remains consistent with the learned landscape. This competence signal enables Energy-Gated DAgger, where persistent energy-consistency violations trigger expert takeover and the resulting recovery trajectories are aggregated for subsequent policy updates. EqC integrates naturally into both Diffusion Transformer policies and flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation, EqC matches or improves control performance and robustness while enabling timely intervention near the policy's competence boundary. A real-world study further shows how these interventions progressively expand the range of situations handled autonomously, providing a practical path from static generative controllers toward self-improving robot systems.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实双臂操作中匹配或提升了控制性能和鲁棒性，并能及时介入策略能力边界；真实世界研究表明干预逐步扩大了自主处理场景的范围。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出平衡能量控制框架EqC，将生成式动作优化转化为平衡寻求优化，并利用优化过程几何特性产生能力信号，实现Energy-Gated DAgger终身学习。
analysis.method: EqC框架将动作生成视为平衡优化，通过条件能量景观计算能量一致性信号，在能量违反持续时触发专家接管，并将恢复轨迹聚合用于后续策略更新；适用于Diffusion Transformer和flow-matching VLA策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于条件能量景观的自省式终身机器人学习框架，通过能量一致性信号触发专家介入和策略更新。

papers.abstract: The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested. We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion - Action - World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 223 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define seven metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of eight SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos 3) required world-state change scores of 0.064-0.240 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions. AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states\footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AffectWorld-Benchmark-370C/}.

analysis.key_results: 八种SoTA世界模型（如Cosmos 3）的世界状态变化得分为0.064-0.240，反事实情感敏感性得分为0.027-0.070，表明现有模型在生成情感驱动动作的后果和适应情感干预方面存在显著差距。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AffectWorld基准，通过三个任务（世界状态一致性、情感-动作一致性、因果一致性）评估情感如何塑造未来世界状态，包含1498个带标注的视频样本和223个反事实样本。
analysis.method: 构建包含情感、动作倾向和原子世界状态约束的标注视频数据集，定义七项指标并结合自动视觉评估与人类校准的VLM/LLM判断。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AffectWorld基准，评估世界模型在情感驱动下的动作和世界状态预测能力。

papers.abstract: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object search involves a closed loop of perception, decision-making, and action under partial observability. Urban environments pose several challenges: large search areas and narrow egocentric views limit coverage, dense 3D geometry constrains safe motion, and open-world instructions require identifying a specific target among distractors. Many existing methods mitigate partial observability through explicit maps or memory representations, yet remain largely reactive, reasoning over past observations without explicitly predicting future states. World models enable prospective reasoning through imagined rollouts. However, image-generating world models can incur high inference latency, while spatially grounded planning remains challenging for latent world models. We propose SearchWorld, a recurrent state-space world model that connects explicit spatial memory with value-guided imagination. The model maintains BEV exploration and obstacle memory and decodes a task-aware spatial value layer to guide search. A cognition-action network uses this learned spatial value prior to improve the policy through imagined rollouts, without training a separate scalar critic. Training progresses from world-model learning to expert imitation and imagination-based exploration refinement. On UAV-ON, SearchWorld improves the success rate to 23.8% (19.5% for the strongest published agent) and raises oracle success to 35.5%, while remaining robust on unseen scenes (19.9% success rate). By grounding imagination in explicit spatial representations, SearchWorld enables UAV agents to plan prospectively rather than react.

analysis.key_results: 在UAV-ON基准上，SearchWorld将成功率提升至23.8%（此前最强智能体为19.5%），oracle成功率提升至35.5%，在未见场景上保持19.9%的成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了SearchWorld，一种将显式空间记忆与价值引导想象相结合的世界模型，通过想象rollout改进策略，无需单独训练标量critic。
analysis.method: 使用循环状态空间世界模型，维护BEV探索与障碍物记忆，解码任务感知的空间价值层，并利用认知-动作网络通过想象rollout优化策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SearchWorld提出了一种结合显式空间记忆与价值引导想象的世界模型，用于无人机对象搜索任务，通过想象式推演提升策略性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向无人机机器人的世界模型（WAM），强调显式空间表征下的想象式规划，对VLA/WAM在机器人寻物任务中的研究具有重要价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.

analysis.key_results: 在R2R-CE验证未见集上，使用4B参数骨干网络达到56.3% SR和51.4% SPL；在RxR-CE上达到54.3% SR，均未使用额外的几何编码器。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种训练框架，通过特权空间和轨迹指导来塑造导航表示，同时保持原始推理路径不变。
analysis.method: 使用冻结的几何基础模型提供多级空间引导，并利用相对航向和专家路线进度目标提供互补的轨迹状态监督；所有辅助组件仅在训练时使用，部署时移除。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: StageVLN在训练阶段利用冻结的几何基础模型与轨迹监督塑造导航表示，推理时无需额外编码器即可提升VLN性能。

papers.abstract: Imitation learning has shown increasing promise for autonomous robotic surgery, yet safe deployment remains challenging due to the safety-critical nature of surgical tasks and the complexity and variability of surgical environments. Failure detection is therefore an essential safeguard, but its development remains difficult due to the challenges of scarce failure data, highly variable manipulation dynamics, and the need to balance missed detections against disruptive false alarms. To address these challenges, we introduce FoMo-FD (Flow-Matching World Model for Failure Detection), a failure detection method that learns nominal short-horizon visual dynamics with an action-conditioned flow-matching world model. FoMo-FD scores the inverse-transport nonconformity of observed endpoint latents, enabling window-level detection of deviations from learned nominal dynamics without requiring failure demonstrations. Detection thresholds are obtained by conformal calibration on successful policy rollouts, yielding task-specific alarms without assuming future failure types. We evaluate FoMo-FD on four surgically relevant manipulation tasks with twenty failure modes across simulation and real-robot experiments using the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). In the wrist view, the main model achieves a 95.6% failure detection rate (FDR) at a 2.5% false alarm rate (FAR), exceeding the FDR of the evaluated observation-based, action-based, and vision-language baselines and alternative scores from the same world model. Across four training seeds, mean wrist-view FDR and FAR are 93.4% and 4.7%, respectively. Online replay yields a mean onset-relative detection delay of 0.98 s for wrist-view failures detected offline. Project website: https://janusmaple.github.io/FoMoFD/

analysis.key_results: 在腕部视图上，主模型达到95.6%的故障检测率（FDR）和2.5%的误报率（FAR），超过观测、动作和视觉语言基线；四次训练种子平均FDR为93.4%，FAR为4.7%；在线回放的平均检测延迟为0.98秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FoMo-FD，一种无需故障示例、利用动作条件的流匹配世界模型来检测故障的方法。
analysis.method: 在学习名义短期视觉动态的流匹配世界模型上，通过逆传输非一致性评分并结合共形校准获得任务特定的检测阈值。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于流匹配世界模型的故障检测方法，通过学习动作条件的短期视觉动态来检测手术机器人模仿策略的偏离。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作将世界模型（world model）用于手术机器人模仿策略的故障检测，属于机器人动作-世界建模的范畴，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision Transformer detectors now approach the accuracy of CNNs but remain difficult to deploy on NPUs and microcontrollers because key components, including deformable attention, feature fusion, and nonlinear activation functions, are not natively compatible with integer arithmetic. Existing quantized detectors either retain operators such as Softmax, GELU, and LayerNorm or focus on heavyweight backbones, leaving lightweight detection transformers without an end-to-end integer implementation. We address this gap with I-LW-DETR, the first fully integer-only lightweight DETR, in which every operation in the forward pass, including transformer nonlinearities, is executed in integer arithmetic. I-LW-DETR is built upon three key components: a scale-preserving split convolution that assigns independent activation scale to each branch of the multi-scale projector; SD-ShiftGELU, a sign-dependent GELU approximation that preserves element-wise behavior while avoiding the accuracy degradation; and a constrained Shiftmax that maintains stable Softmax normalization. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed quantization pipeline consistently produces efficient fully integer-only models across different model scales. Across all model scales, the proposed pipeline incurs only a moderate accuracy degradation while reducing the model size by approximately $3.6\times$ and the computational cost by more than one order of magnitude.

analysis.key_results: 量化流程在不同模型尺度上始终产生高效的完全整数模型；在所有尺度上仅导致适度精度下降，同时模型尺寸减少约3.6倍，计算成本降低超过一个数量级。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出I-LW-DETR，首个完全整数仅用轻量级DETR，其中前向传播的每个操作（包括transformer非线性）均以整数算术执行，通过三个关键组件实现：尺度保持分割卷积、SD-ShiftGELU和约束Shiftmax。
analysis.method: 三个关键组件：尺度保持分割卷积（为多尺度投影器的每个分支分配独立激活尺度）、SD-ShiftGELU（符号依赖的GELU近似，保持逐元素行为）以及约束Shiftmax（保持稳定的Softmax归一化）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出I-LW-DETR，首个完全整数运算的轻量级DETR检测器，使所有前向操作（包括非线性）均在整数算术中执行。

papers.abstract: Ternary Vision Transformers offer substantial model compression, however state-of-the-art methods only ternarize the encoder layers, leaving patch embeddings, LayerNorm parameters, and classifier heads in full precision. In compact models targeting resource-constrained processors, such as microcontrollers, these remaining full-precision components determine the total memory footprint, severely limiting deployment efficiency and on-device feasibility. In this work, we introduce a fully ternarized Vision Transformer in which all weight matrices and normalization parameters are ternarized, while activations remain 8-bit (FTerViT). To this end, we introduce two novel operators: TernaryBitConv2d with per-channel scaling for patch embedding and TernaryLayerNorm. FTerViT is trained using knowledge distillation, followed by a lightweight quantization-aware recovery phase. On a matched DeiT-S backbone, FTerViT reaches 77.47% ImageNet-1K top-1 at 5.81 MB, +3.27 pp over TerViT. With the stronger DeiT-III-S backbone at 384x384 resolution, our ternary W2A8 model achieves 82.43% at 6.09 MB (~15x compression, -2.42 pp vs. FP32). This backbone- and resolution-advantaged result exceeds prior ternary ViTs by up to 8 pp. Finally, we demonstrate the first implementation of ternary vision transformers on a dual-core Xtensa LX7 microcontroller inside the ESP32-S3 system-on-chip. By deploying FTerViT-Small (based on DeiT-III-Small at 224x224 resolution, 5.81 MB), we achieve 79.64% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy.

analysis.key_results: DeiT-S骨干网络达到77.47% ImageNet-1K top-1（5.81 MB），比TerViT高3.27个百分点；DeiT-III-S骨干（384x384）达到82.43%（6.09 MB，约15倍压缩，比FP32低2.42个百分点）；部署在ESP32-S3上，FTerViT-Small（基于DeiT-III-Small 224x224，5.81 MB）达到79.64% top-1。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FTerViT，将Vision Transformer的所有权重矩阵和归一化参数三元化，引入TernaryBitConv2d和TernaryLayerNorm算子，并在ESP32-S3微控制器上实现部署。
analysis.method: 知识蒸馏训练，随后进行轻量级量化感知恢复阶段；使用TernaryBitConv2d进行逐通道缩放的patch embedding，TernaryLayerNorm进行归一化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FTerViT提出全三元视觉Transformer，所有权重矩阵和归一化参数均三元化，激活保持8位，实现极致压缩与微控制器部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于视觉Transformer的模型量化，未涉及VLA、机器人世界模型或动作预测，与本站主题无直接关系，但其量化方法对高效推理有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Modern image encoders achieve high generalization by decoupling semantic meaning from resolution, an ability yet to be fully realized in the 3D domain. We investigate the failure of 3D point cloud encoders to achieve similar generalization and find that existing models are highly sensitive to sampling resolution and scale changes, leading to significant performance degradation. This sensitivity is a major bottleneck for real-world deployment in robotics, as it suggests models overfit to specific quantization densities and object scales rather than learning invariant semantic features. To mitigate this dependency, we propose Invaria, a point cloud encoder that achieves scale and density invariance through next-resolution prediction and receptive field calibration. While our objective is not the explicit generation of high-resolution point clouds, we find that this training objective encourages the model to learn robust, structural invariants. The resulting encoder achieves significant performance gains during resolution shifts while maintaining high efficiency through a compact model size and reduced token requirements. Specifically, on ScanNet, Invaria achieves a 56.0\% higher mIoU at 3$\times$ lower resolution and a 20\% improvement when the objects scale is reduced by a factor of 3. These gains are achieved with a 45\% smaller model size and an average reduction of 40\% in input tokens.

analysis.key_results: 在ScanNet上，3倍低分辨率下mIoU提高56.0%，物体尺度缩小3倍时性能提升20%；模型大小减小45%，输入令牌平均减少40%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Invaria点云编码器，通过下一分辨率预测和感受野校准实现尺度与密度不变性，在分辨率变化时性能显著提升，并保持紧凑模型和降低令牌需求。
analysis.method: 下一分辨率预测训练目标和感受野校准，学习尺度与密度不变的语义特征。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出点云编码器Invaria，通过下一分辨率预测和感受野校准实现尺度与密度不变性，提高分辨率变化时的泛化性能并降低模型大小与令牌需求。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注点云编码器的尺度/密度不变性及高效推理，未直接涉及VLA或WAM；其模型量化（通过紧凑模型和减少令牌）与高效推理相关，对机器人部署有间接价值。

papers.abstract: Large-scale pretraining has made Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promising foundations for generalist robot manipulation, yet adapting them to downstream tasks remains necessary. However, the common practice of full fine-tuning treats pretraining as initialization and can shift broad priors toward narrow training-distribution patterns. We propose PriorVLA, a novel framework that preserves pretrained priors and learns to leverage them for effective adaptation. PriorVLA keeps a frozen Prior Expert as a read-only prior source and trains an Adaptation Expert for downstream specialization. Expert Queries capture scene priors from the pretrained VLM and motor priors from the Prior Expert, integrating both into the Adaptation Expert to guide adaptation. Together, PriorVLA updates only 25% of the parameters updated by full fine-tuning. Across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world tasks, PriorVLA achieves stronger overall performance than full fine-tuning and state-of-the-art VLA baselines, with the largest gains under out-of-distribution (OOD) and few-shot settings. PriorVLA improves over pi0.5 by 11 points on RoboTwin 2.0-Hard and achieves 99.1% average success on LIBERO. Across eight real-world tasks and two embodiments, PriorVLA reaches 81% in-distribution (ID) and 57% OOD success with standard data. With only 10 demonstrations per task, PriorVLA reaches 48% ID and 32% OOD success, surpassing pi0.5 by 24 and 22 points, respectively.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 和真实世界任务上，PriorVLA 超越全微调和最先进 VLA 基线；在 RoboTwin 2.0-Hard 上比 pi0.5 提高 11 个百分点；在 LIBERO 上平均成功率达到 99.1%；在 8 个真实世界任务和两种执行器上，标准数据下 ID 成功率 81%、OOD 成功率 57%；每任务仅 10 个演示时，ID 成功率 48%、OOD 成功率 32%，分别比 pi0.5 高 24 和 22 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PriorVLA 框架，冻结先验专家作为只读先验源，训练适配专家用于下游专业化，通过专家查询将场景先验与动作先验整合到适配专家中，实现参数高效的先验保留适配。
analysis.method: 冻结先验专家，训练适配专家；专家查询从预训练 VLM 和先验专家中提取场景先验与动作先验，并整合到适配专家中以引导适配；仅更新全微调 25% 的参数。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PriorVLA 提出一种新的 VLA 适配框架，通过保留预训练先验并学习利用这些先验，仅更新全微调 25% 参数即可在下游任务上超越全微调和现有最优方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心主题为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的适配，属于 VLA 核心研究内容；提出的先验保留适配方法旨在保持预训练先验、改善泛化能力和少样本性能，对下游机器人操作任务具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Personalizing a text-to-image diffusion model by full fine-tuning gives the strongest subject fidelity but produces a full copy of the model per subject: a thousand personalized Stable Diffusion checkpoints approach five terabytes, so storage, not compute, is what fails to scale. We present Delta-SVD, which compresses the weight change that personalization makes rather than the model. Given only a finished checkpoint and its base, it takes a truncated SVD of each layer's weight delta and keeps the few components that carry its spectral energy, selected by a per-layer energy threshold or by a global byte budget filled by water-filling, optimal for the continuous relaxation and empirically near-optimal for discrete rank allocation. Nothing is trained and no subject image is read, so the method applies to legacy and third-party checkpoints for which training-time adapters such as LoRA were never produced. The factors merge back into dense weights at load time, so serving runs at the uncompressed model's exact latency, whereas whole-model 8-bit and 4-bit quantization slow inference by 1.5-3.4 times. On the 30-subject DreamBooth benchmark, Delta-SVD matches the uncompressed model to within 0.01 DINO at 7-fold compression and keeps 98% of its fidelity at 33-fold compression. Among post-hoc baselines, only dense-delta quantization at 411 MiB matches it; below that size Delta-SVD dominates pruning, random-rank selection, and both whole-model and dense-delta quantization on the storage-quality frontier. The same holds on 84 diverse CustomConcept101 subjects, where a 9 MiB adapter reproduces the uncompressed outputs at paired DINO 0.77, and on a fully fine-tuned SD3.5-medium MMDiT, where a 531 MB adapter matches the uncompressed model to within 0.01 DINO.

analysis.key_results: 在30主体DreamBooth基准上，7倍压缩时与未压缩模型DINO差距在0.01以内，33倍压缩时保持98%保真度；在84主体CustomConcept101和SD3.5-medium上同样表现优异。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Delta-SVD方法，对个性化模型与基座模型之间的权重差进行截断奇异值分解，并按层能量阈值或全局字节预算（water-filling）分配秩，实现存储压缩且推理延迟不变。
analysis.method: 对已完成微调的个性化模型与基座模型逐层权重差进行截断SVD，保留主要奇异值分量；秩分配采用逐层能量阈值或全局字节预算下的注水算法，加载时合并回稠密权重。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Delta-SVD，通过截断SVD压缩个性化扩散模型相对基座模型的权重增量，在不训练、不读取图像的情况下实现存储高效且推理零开销的压缩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型的权重增量压缩，与VLA或机器人世界模型无直接关系；但所提Delta-SVD作为独立后处理压缩技术，在原理上可迁移用于压缩机器人策略或世界模型的权重增量，具有潜在方法学价值。
